title: ReAl: Refine neural operators via aligning dynamical flow
abstract: arXiv:2610.20369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural partial differential equation (PDE) surrogates trained with mean squared error (MSE) can capture dominant dynamics but often lose high-frequency information and fine-scale structures. Generative models (e.g., Flow Matching) can capture the distribution of fine-scale details, yet stochastic errors may accumulate during autoregressive rollouts and compromise long-term stability. To address these limitations, we introduce Refine and Align(ReAl), a model-agnostic plug-in that augments pretrained PDE surrogates to improve the reconstruction of high-frequency structures associated with complex physical phenomena. In the refinement stage, a conditional flow-matching model learns the residual distribution around the deterministic base prediction, recovering missing fine-scale structures while retaining the dominant dynamics. translated_title: ReAl：通过对齐动力学流来精炼神经算子
translated_abstract: 使用均方误差（MSE）训练的神经偏微分方程（PDE）代理模型能够捕捉主导动力学，但常常丢失高频信息和细尺度结构。生成模型（例如流匹配，Flow Matching）可以捕捉细尺度细节的分布，然而在自回归滚动预测过程中，随机误差可能会不断累积，从而损害长期稳定性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 Refine and Align（ReAl），这是一个与模型无关的即插即用模块，可用于增强预训练的 PDE 代理模型，以改善与复杂物理现象相关的高频结构的重建。在精炼阶段，条件流匹配模型学习确定性基础预测周围的残差分布，在保留主导动力学的同时恢复缺失的细尺度结构。在对齐阶段，为了减轻在自回归滚动预测中被放大的生成差异，粒子（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ReAl 是一个模型无关的即插即用方法，通过条件流匹配模型精炼预训练 PDE 代理模型的细尺度结构，并通过对齐动力学流来抑制自回归滚动预测中的生成误差累积，从而在保持长期稳定性的同时改善高频结构的重建。
en_tdlr: ReAl is a model-agnostic plug-in that refines pretrained PDE surrogates with a conditional flow-matching model and aligns dynamical flow to mitigate generative error accumulation in autoregressive rollouts, improving the reconstruction of high-frequency structures while maintaining long-term stability.
